theorems.name: vunop__is_wf
theorems.proof:
:= by
  intro h _ _ hv hne heq
  subst heq
  cases h <;> subst_vars
  all_goals first
    -- the `none` fallback (case_26) contradicts `var_0 ≠ none`
    | exact absurd rfl hne
    -- integer ABS (case_0-3): the result lanes `var_0_lst` are tied to the input lanes by `Forall₂` and the
    -- length premise `var_0_lst.length = lane_1_lst.length`
    | exact iswf_Forall_singleton (iswf_vunop_Jnn_inv_lanes iabs__is_wf ‹_› hv ‹_› ‹_› ‹_› ‹_›)
    -- integer NEG/POPCNT (case_4-11): lane-wise `Map` with a wf premise for every result lane
    | exact iswf_Forall_singleton (iswf_inv_lanes_of_Forall_Map ‹_› ‹_›)
    -- float operators (case_12-25): `setproduct_` of the per-lane results, each with a wf premise
    | exact iswf_vunop_setproduct_inv_lanes ‹_› ‹_›
theorems.notes: Proved; no sorry. #print axioms: inv_lanes__is_wf, lanes__is_wf, propext, Quot.sound only (no sorryAx, no Classical.choice). The probe type is == the module's statement (checked by #eval in Final.lean). A per-constructor diagnostic (Diag.lean/Diag.log) confirms which alternative closes each case: case_26 (none) by absurd; case_0-3 (int ABS) by the new length-based helper, which uses the restored premise `(List.length var_0_lst) = (List.length lane_1_lst)` (5th premise; the duplicate `var_2_lst` premise is the 1st); case_4-11 (NEG/POPCNT) by the module lemma iswf_inv_lanes_of_Forall_Map; case_12-25 (float) by a new setproduct helper. The proof does not depend on premise order: hypotheses are found by `‹_›` (assumption) after `subst_vars`. This is the same style as the module's vrelop__is_wf and lcvtop___is_wf. No Inhabited default is needed: only `Option.get!` on `some`, `proj_lane__0` on constructors and `fun_lanetype` on `shape.X` are reduced. Reused module lemmas: iswf_Forall_singleton, iswf_inv_lanes_of_Forall_Map, iswf_Forall₂_exists_of_mem_left, iswf_fun_lsizenn_lsize, iswf_fun_lsize_det, iswf_Forall_map/nil/append. No HelperPool29 lemma is used.

theorems.name: vbinop__is_wf
theorems.proof:
:= by
  intro h _ _ hv1 hv2 hne heq
  subst heq
  cases h <;> subst_vars
  all_goals first
    -- the `none` fallback (case_52) contradicts `var_0 ≠ none`
    | exact absurd rfl hne
    -- integer ADD/SUB/MUL/AVGR_U/Q15MULR_SAT_S (case_0-7, 24-35): lane-wise `Map₂` with a wf premise
    | exact iswf_Forall_singleton (iswf_inv_lanes_of_Forall₂_Map₂ ‹_› ‹_›)
    -- float operators (case_36-51): `setproduct_` of the per-lane-pair results, each with a wf premise
    | exact iswf_vbinop_setproduct_inv_lanes ‹_› ‹_›
    -- integer MIN/MAX/ADD_SAT/SUB_SAT (case_8-23): the result lanes `var_0_lst` are tied to the input lanes by
    -- `Forall₃` and the length premises `var_0_lst.length = lane_1_lst.length = lane_2_lst.length`
    | exact iswf_Forall_singleton (iswf_vbinop_Jnn_inv_lanes imin__is_wf ‹_› hv1 hv2 ‹_› ‹_› ‹_› ‹_› ‹_› ‹_›)
    | exact iswf_Forall_singleton (iswf_vbinop_Jnn_inv_lanes imax__is_wf ‹_› hv1 hv2 ‹_› ‹_› ‹_› ‹_› ‹_› ‹_›)
    | exact iswf_Forall_singleton (iswf_vbinop_Jnn_inv_lanes iadd_sat__is_wf ‹_› hv1 hv2 ‹_› ‹_› ‹_› ‹_› ‹_› ‹_›)
    | exact iswf_Forall_singleton (iswf_vbinop_Jnn_inv_lanes isub_sat__is_wf ‹_› hv1 hv2 ‹_› ‹_› ‹_› ‹_› ‹_› ‹_›)
theorems.notes:
Proved; no sorry. #print axioms: inv_lanes__is_wf, lanes__is_wf, propext, Quot.sound only. The probe type is == the module's statement. The diagnostic confirms the case mapping: case_52 (none) by absurd; case_0-7 and 24-35 (ADD/SUB/MUL/AVGR_U/Q15MULR_SAT_S) by the module lemma iswf_inv_lanes_of_Forall₂_Map₂; case_36-51 (float) by a new setproduct helper; case_8-11 MIN, 12-15 MAX, 16-19 ADD_SAT, 20-23 SUB_SAT by the new Forall₃ helper with imin__is_wf, imax__is_wf, iadd_sat__is_wf and isub_sat__is_wf. Those 16 constructors carry the restored length premises `(List.length var_0_lst) = (List.length lane_1_lst)` and `(List.length var_0_lst) = (List.length lane_2_lst)` (premises 7-8). They also have the same pair for the duplicate `var_2_lst` (premises 1-2) and `(List.length lane_1_lst) = (List.length lane_2_lst)` (premise 16). The proof does not depend on premise order and uses no Inhabited default.

For the main session (not a model issue): I first used HelperPool29's iswf_inv_lanes_setproduct_map(₂) (Final_v1_pool.lean compiles). Simulating your real assembler (final29.build on the pristine repo wasm2.0.lean, output only in my asm/ dir) showed that the assembled file would not compile. iswf_Forall_setproduct calls iswf_Forall_setproduct1, but the assembler dropped setproduct1 and setproduct2 as 'unused'. The cause: assemble2's split_stmt_proof finds no top-level ':=' in equation-compiler-style helpers (`| [], _ => ...`), so their body reads as empty and the helpers they call are never tracked. In parts_bundle23.json this affects iswf_Forall_setproduct, iswf_Forall_setproduct1 and iswf_Forall_setproduct2. iswf_Forall_Map₂ has the same style but calls no other helper, so it is harmless. I avoided the chain with the tactic-style iswf_setproduct_Forall_Forall. With my final texts, the simulated assembly has no reference to a helper defined later, and your check_placement.py reports 0 problems. A Lean check (PlaceCheck.log) confirms that all 97 uses of model constants in my terms are declared above vunop__is_wf/vbinop__is_wf.

Model observation (not blocking, not an unprovability): the float constructors (fun_vunop_ case_12-25, fun_vbinop_ case_36-51) use `Option.get! (proj_lane__1 l)` with no `proj_lane__1 l ≠ none` premise, while every integer constructor has `proj_lane__0 l ≠ none` premises. The wf theorems do not need it, because the float constructors carry wf premises for the computed results. The ABS/MIN/MAX/ADD_SAT/SUB_SAT constructors also contain the result list twice (`var_2_lst` and `var_0_lst`, apparently one per Sideconditions run). The generated wf premise mentions only `var_2_lst`, while the result is built from `var_0_lst`, so the proofs go through the length premise instead.

helpers.name: iswf_lane_proj0_payload_wf
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_lane_proj0_payload_wf {lt : lanetype} {w : Nat} {l : lane_}
    (hl : wf_lane_ lt l) (hw : fun_lsizenn lt w) (hp : proj_lane__0 l ≠ none) :
    wf_uN w (Option.get! (proj_lane__0 l)) := by
  cases hl with
  | lane__case_0 J x w' hs hx heq =>
    subst heq
    obtain rfl := iswf_fun_lsize_det hs (iswf_fun_lsizenn_lsize hw)
    exact hx
  | lane__case_1 => exact absurd rfl hp

helpers.name: iswf_Forall₃_exists_of_mem_left
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_Forall₃_exists_of_mem_left {α β γ : Type} {R : α → β → γ → Prop} {xs : List α} {ys : List β}
    {zs : List γ} (h1 : xs.length = ys.length) (h2 : xs.length = zs.length) (h : Forall₃ R xs ys zs) :
    ∀ x ∈ xs, ∃ y ∈ ys, ∃ z ∈ zs, R x y z := by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := iswf_Forall₂_exists_of_mem_left (R := fun a b => (a, b) ∈ xs.zip ys) h1
    (fun t ht => ht) x hx
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hr⟩ := iswf_Forall₂_exists_of_mem_left (R := fun (p : α × β) (c : γ) => R p.1 p.2 c)
    (by rw [List.length_zip]; omega) h (x, y) hxy
  exact ⟨y, hy, z, hz, hr⟩

helpers.name: iswf_vunop_Jnn_inv_lanes
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_vunop_Jnn_inv_lanes {J : Jnn} {M w : Nat} {op : N → iN → iN → Prop} {v : vec_} {xs : List uN}
    (hop : ∀ (v_N : N) (i ret x : iN), op v_N i x → wf_uN v_N i → ret = x → wf_uN v_N ret)
    (hsh : wf_shape (shape.X (lanetype_Jnn J) (dim.mk_dim M))) (hv : wf_uN 128 v)
    (hw : fun_lsizenn (lanetype_Jnn J) w)
    (hp : Forall (fun l => proj_lane__0 l ≠ none) (lanes_ (shape.X (lanetype_Jnn J) (dim.mk_dim M)) v))
    (hlen : xs.length = (lanes_ (shape.X (lanetype_Jnn J) (dim.mk_dim M)) v).length)
    (hR : Forall₂ (fun x l => op w (Option.get! (proj_lane__0 l)) x) xs
      (lanes_ (shape.X (lanetype_Jnn J) (dim.mk_dim M)) v)) :
    wf_uN 128 (inv_lanes_ (shape.X (lanetype_Jnn J) (dim.mk_dim M)) (Map (fun x => lane_.mk_lane__0 J x) xs)) := by
  refine iswf_inv_lanes_of_Forall_Map hsh fun x hx => ?_
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hxl⟩ := iswf_Forall₂_exists_of_mem_left hlen hR x hx
  exact wf_lane_.lane__case_0 _ J x w (iswf_fun_lsizenn_lsize hw)
    (hop _ _ _ _ hxl (iswf_lane_proj0_payload_wf (lanes__is_wf _ _ _ hsh hv rfl l hl) hw (hp l hl)) rfl) rfl

helpers.name: iswf_vbinop_Jnn_inv_lanes
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_vbinop_Jnn_inv_lanes {J : Jnn} {M w : Nat} {s : sx} {op : N → sx → iN → iN → iN → Prop}
    {v1 v2 : vec_} {xs : List uN}
    (hop : ∀ (v_N : N) (v_sx : sx) (i1 i2 ret x : iN),
      op v_N v_sx i1 i2 x → wf_uN v_N i1 → wf_uN v_N i2 → ret = x → wf_uN v_N ret)
    (hsh : wf_shape (shape.X (lanetype_Jnn J) (dim.mk_dim M))) (hv1 : wf_uN 128 v1) (hv2 : wf_uN 128 v2)
    (hw : fun_lsizenn (lanetype_Jnn J) w)
    (hp1 : Forall (fun l => proj_lane__0 l ≠ none) (lanes_ (shape.X (lanetype_Jnn J) (dim.mk_dim M)) v1))
    (hp2 : Forall (fun l => proj_lane__0 l ≠ none) (lanes_ (shape.X (lanetype_Jnn J) (dim.mk_dim M)) v2))
    (hlen1 : xs.length = (lanes_ (shape.X (lanetype_Jnn J) (dim.mk_dim M)) v1).length)
    (hlen2 : xs.length = (lanes_ (shape.X (lanetype_Jnn J) (dim.mk_dim M)) v2).length)
    (hR : Forall₃ (fun x l1 l2 => op w s (Option.get! (proj_lane__0 l1)) (Option.get! (proj_lane__0 l2)) x) xs
      (lanes_ (shape.X (lanetype_Jnn J) (dim.mk_dim M)) v1) (lanes_ (shape.X (lanetype_Jnn J) (dim.mk_dim M)) v2)) :
    wf_uN 128 (inv_lanes_ (shape.X (lanetype_Jnn J) (dim.mk_dim M)) (Map (fun x => lane_.mk_lane__0 J x) xs)) := by
  refine iswf_inv_lanes_of_Forall_Map hsh fun x hx => ?_
  obtain ⟨l1, hl1, l2, hl2, hxl⟩ := iswf_Forall₃_exists_of_mem_left hlen1 hlen2 hR x hx
  exact wf_lane_.lane__case_0 _ J x w (iswf_fun_lsizenn_lsize hw)
    (hop _ _ _ _ _ _ hxl
      (iswf_lane_proj0_payload_wf (lanes__is_wf _ _ _ hsh hv1 rfl l1 hl1) hw (hp1 l1 hl1))
      (iswf_lane_proj0_payload_wf (lanes__is_wf _ _ _ hsh hv2 rfl l2 hl2) hw (hp2 l2 hl2)) rfl) rfl

helpers.name: iswf_setproduct_Forall_Forall
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_setproduct_Forall_Forall {X : Type} {P : X → Prop} (lls : List (List X))
    (h : Forall (Forall P) lls) : Forall (Forall P) (setproduct_ X lls) := by
  -- `setproduct2_ X w R` puts `w` in front of every list of `R`
  have h2 : ∀ (w : X) (R : List (List X)), P w → Forall (Forall P) R →
      Forall (Forall P) (setproduct2_ X w R) := by
    intro w R hw hR
    induction R with
    | nil => exact iswf_Forall_nil _
    | cons r R ih =>
      exact iswf_Forall_append
        (iswf_Forall_singleton (iswf_Forall_append (iswf_Forall_singleton hw) (hR r (List.mem_cons_self ..))))
        (ih (fun m hm => hR m (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hm)))
  -- `setproduct1_ X l R` does that for every `w ∈ l` and concatenates the results
  have h1 : ∀ (l : List X) (R : List (List X)), Forall P l → Forall (Forall P) R →
      Forall (Forall P) (setproduct1_ X l R) := by
    intro l R hl hR
    induction l with
    | nil => exact iswf_Forall_nil _
    | cons w l ih =>
      exact iswf_Forall_append (h2 w R (hl w (List.mem_cons_self ..)) hR)
        (ih (fun x hx => hl x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx)))
  induction lls with
  | nil => exact iswf_Forall_singleton (iswf_Forall_nil _)
  | cons l lls ih =>
    exact h1 l _ (h l (List.mem_cons_self ..)) (ih (fun m hm => h m (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hm)))

helpers.name: iswf_vunop_setproduct_inv_lanes
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_vunop_setproduct_inv_lanes {α β : Type} {sh : shape} {g : β → lane_} {k : α → List β} {l : List α}
    (hsh : wf_shape sh) (h : Forall (fun x => Forall (fun y => wf_lane_ (fun_lanetype sh) (g y)) (k x)) l) :
    Forall (fun v => wf_uN 128 v)
      (Map (fun ls => inv_lanes_ sh ls) (setproduct_ lane_ (Map (fun x => Map g (k x)) l))) :=
  iswf_Forall_map _ _
    (iswf_setproduct_Forall_Forall _ (iswf_Forall_map _ _ h (fun _ hx => iswf_Forall_map _ _ hx (fun _ hy => hy))))
    (fun _ hls => inv_lanes__is_wf _ _ _ hsh hls rfl)

helpers.name: iswf_vbinop_setproduct_inv_lanes
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_vbinop_setproduct_inv_lanes {α β γ : Type} {sh : shape} {g : γ → lane_} {k : α → β → List γ}
    {l1 : List α} {l2 : List β} (hsh : wf_shape sh)
    (h : Forall₂ (fun a b => Forall (fun y => wf_lane_ (fun_lanetype sh) (g y)) (k a b)) l1 l2) :
    Forall (fun v => wf_uN 128 v)
      (Map (fun ls => inv_lanes_ sh ls) (setproduct_ lane_ (Map₂ (fun a b => Map g (k a b)) l1 l2))) :=
  iswf_Forall_map _ _
    (iswf_setproduct_Forall_Forall _
      (iswf_Forall_Map₂ _ _ _ (fun t ht => iswf_Forall_map _ _ (h t ht) (fun _ hy => hy))))
    (fun _ hls => inv_lanes__is_wf _ _ _ hsh hls rfl)
